headline: Nevis raised $70 million for an AI operating system for wealth management
body: Nevis, a startup founded by former Revolut executives, has raised $70 million in a Series B round led by EQT Ventures. It is building an AI operating system for wealth management.
note: A former Revolut team building AI for wealth managers is a useful signal for banks watching the wealth segment.

evidence.text: Nevis, a startup founded by former Revolut executives that is building an AI operating system for wealth management, has raised $70 million in a Series B funding round led by EQT Ventures.
